beats.text: Six subtle signs of high intelligence — the ones that don't show up on a test.
One. You talk to yourself. Narrating your thinking actually sharpens it.
Two. You get so absorbed in things you lose all track of time.
Three. You're comfortable saying 'I don't know' — and genuinely curious to find out.
Four. You distrust answers that are too simple, and look for the part that doesn't fit.
Five. You adapt quickly. Dropped into something new, you find the pattern fast.
Six. You're often your own harshest critic. Smart minds see their own gaps most clearly.
Intelligence isn't only speed or memory. Often it's curiosity that simply never switched off.
